description: The pie chart represents the distribution of responses to a survey question about the effectiveness of various defense strategies against social engineering attacks. The chart is divided into four categories, each represented by a different color. The largest segment, in red, represents 'Not Deceived' and accounts for 67.6% of the responses. The second largest segment, in yellow, represents 'Deceived' and makes up 57.9% of the responses. The third segment, in green, represents 'Partially Deceived' and constitutes 31.6% of the responses. The smallest segment, in dark green, represents 'Ambiguity 2 (Inner)' and accounts for 10.5% of the responses. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by size, with 'Not Deceived' being the most common response and 'Ambiguity 2 (Inner)' being the least common.
